data.key: Mythic Path Ability ~ Shout of Defiance
data.name: Shout of Defiance
data.description: You can channel holy energy into a righteous shout of defiance. As a standard action, you can expend one use of mythic power and one use of either channel energy or lay on hands to create a 100-foot spread of healing energy. All allies within this spread heal a number of hit points equal to 1d6+%1. If this brings an ally from negative hit points to 0 hit points or more, the ally can immediately stand up from prone without provoking an attack of opportunity.|Ability_ShoutofDefiance_Heal
